policies.title: Rotation policies
policies.intro: Which accounts the chats of a project may use, in which order, and at what usage to move on to the next. A project with no policy follows the global rotation settings.
policies.noneHint: Every project follows the global rotation settings.
policies.projectsHint: A project has at most one policy.
policies.thresholdHint: A chat stays on its account until the account's binding window crosses this.
policies.orderHint: Add accounts to limit the policy to them, and order them. A chat takes the first one with room.
policies.addAccount: Add an account to the order
policies.saveFailed: The policy could not be saved
policies.deleteBody: Its projects go back to the global rotation settings. Chats already running stay on their accounts.
policies.looseChatsHint: Also govern the chats started in a directory that is under no imported project. Without this, they follow the global rotation settings.
policies.looseChatsTaken: Another policy already governs the chats without a project: at most one may.
policies.reserves: keeps {{points}} points on {{name}} while it has work
policies.rulesInProject: Preferred account, reserve and strict configuration are set in each project's settings.

history.title: Usage history
history.intro: How much of each rate-limit window an account used, from the readings Claude reports while it runs and the CLI's cache while an account is idle.
history.noneHint: Readings arrive as runs report them. A range from before the first run has none.
history.chartTitle: Share of the rate-limit window used, over time
history.describeSeries: {{account}}: {{latest}} now, at most {{peak}} in the range.
history.table: Show the figures as a table
history.tableCaption: Usage readings per account in the chosen window and range

page.title: Accounts
page.noneHint: Sign in with a Claude account to run chats.

card.noLimitsApiKey: An API key has no usage limits to read.
card.expiredHint: Its session ended and could not be refreshed. It is out of rotation until you sign in again.
card.incompleteHint: Its stored sign-in is incomplete (no refresh token). It is out of rotation until you sign in again.

use.last-resort: Claudio spends them as a last resort

card.noLimitsToken: The CLI gives no usage for a token. Limits show here once a chat runs on this account.
card.reservedFor: Keeps headroom for {{projects}} while it has work

toast.preferFailed: Could not make {{name}} the preferred account
toast.refreshFailed: Could not read the usage of {{names}}

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: Claudio forgets the account and deletes its config directory. Chats already started on it keep their transcripts.

holdOut.title: Hold out {{name}}?
holdOut.preferredBody: It is your preferred account: new work will start on another one.
holdOut.lastBody: Claudio will have no account to start work on.

dialog.title: Add an account

hint.login: Signs in with Claude Code in a config directory of its own. Claudio never reads the credentials.
hint.api-key: An API key. It has no identity and no usage limits to read, so it needs an alias.

dialog.aliasOptional: Optional: shown instead of the email.
dialog.aliasRequired: Required: shown wherever the account is named.
dialog.emailHint: Optional: pre-fills the email the sign-in asks for.
dialog.secretHint: Write-only: it is kept in a private file of the account and never shown again.
dialog.addFailed: The account could not be added

rules.join_one: Allow it on the projects with a rule
rules.join_other: Allow it on the projects of the {{count}} rules
rules.on: It joins the list of accounts allowed there.
rules.off_one: The rule stays as it is: it does not work there.
rules.off_other: The rules stay as they are: it does not work there.

dialog.joinFailed: The account was added, but it could not join every project rule

signIn.title: Sign in to the account
signIn.open: Open this page and sign in
signIn.approve: Approve the access for Claude Code
signIn.codeHint: Only if the page shows a code because the browser could not open on its own.
signIn.starting: Asking Claude Code for the sign-in page…

rotation.title: Switching accounts
rotation.subtitle: What work does when an account reaches its limit.
rotation.rotateHint: Off: a chat waits for its account to reset instead of moving to another.
rotation.thresholdAt: counts as at its limit from {{percent}} of 5 h or 7 days
rotation.strategyHint: Where work goes when the preferred account is full.
rotation.hysteresisHint: Points below the threshold an account must fall before it is chosen again.
rotation.cooldownHint: How long an account that hit a limit is left alone when its reset is unknown.
rotation.appliesWhenOn: Applies when switching at the limit is on
rotation.order: The order accounts are taken in
rotation.updateFailed: The settings could not be saved

credits.title: Usage credits
credits.capFor: Monthly cap on the credits of {{name}}

consequence.never: Never spent: work waits for the plan to reset
consequence.last-resort: Spent only when no account has plan quota left
consequence.allow: Spent like plan quota once the plan runs out

credits.noCapHint: up to the cap set at claude.ai

newAccountConfigHint.shared: The default account's configuration, kept in sync.
newAccountConfigHint.independent: Their own, from a copy of the shared configuration.

log.title: Switches and waits
log.hint: A chat that moves to another account, or waits for a reset, appears here.
log.once: for one turn, outside the project's rule

modelFallbacks.title: Model fallbacks
modelFallbacks.intro: When no account with room can run a chat's model, the chat waits. A fallback lets it continue on another model you accepted here; nothing changes model on its own.
modelFallbacks.noneHint: Chats wait for an account that can run their model.
modelFallbacks.noSuggestion: No suggestion for {{model}}. The decision point may be off, or no other account offers a model close to it.
modelFallbacks.suggestFailed: Could not ask for a suggestion

reason.rule: not allowed by the project's rule

basis.current: the work is already on it
basis.order: first in the order with room
basis.same-config: shares the configuration of the current account
basis.over-threshold: none was under its threshold, so it runs rather than waits
basis.reserve-released: uses the headroom another project keeps, because every other account is out

passedOver.not-allowed: not allowed by the project's rule

canary.label: Claude Code {{version}}
canary.heading: Checks for shared accounts
canary.againFailed: The checks could not be started
canary.failed: This version behaves differently from what shared accounts rely on. Nothing was changed: accounts keep working as they were.
canary.needsSignIn: The CLI would not run some checks without an account signed in, and none was used.
canary.couldNotRun: These checks could not run, so nothing is known about them yet.

whenFailed.s1: The CLI may replace a linked state file when it writes.
whenFailed.s2: A plugin install may replace a linked plugins folder or settings file.
whenFailed.s3c: A project's trust may no longer be read from the account.
whenFailed.s6: The CLI may no longer accept a sign-in copied from another account, so shared accounts are not given the default's MCP sign-ins.

config.label: Configuration

halfway.shared: A switch to the shared configuration was left half-way: Repair finishes it.
halfway.independent: A switch to its own configuration was left half-way: Repair finishes it.

config.missing_one: Waits for its link to the shared one:
config.missing_other: Wait for their links to the shared ones:

holds.link-elsewhere: This account: a link to another place
holds.aside-taken: This account: its own copy, and the place to keep it aside is taken
holds.failed: This account: it could not be changed (the server log says why)

sharedHolds.history: Shared: the history every account uses

config.useSharedBody: The account's own copy is kept in <path>{{aside}}</path> inside its folder, and the shared one takes its place. Nothing is deleted.
config.useSharedBodyNoAside: The shared one takes its place. Nothing is deleted.

toast.switchFailed: Could not change the configuration of {{name}}
toast.repairFailed: Could not repair the configuration of {{name}}

plugins.after: Claudio brings them in line by itself.

signIns.lead: MCP sign-ins differ from the default:
signIns.rotating_one: needs its own sign-in on this account: it signs in once per account.
signIns.rotating_other: need their own sign-in on this account: each signs in once per account.
signIns.ownOnly_one: is signed in only on this account: sign in on the default to share it.
signIns.ownOnly_other: are signed in only on this account: sign in on the default to share them.
signIns.missing_one: is not copied from the default yet: Claudio does it once this account is free.
signIns.missing_other: are not copied from the default yet: Claudio does it once this account is free.

configDialog.introOwn: {{name}} keeps its settings, instructions, agents and the rest in its own folder. Changes to the shared configuration stop reaching it.
configDialog.introShared: {{name}} uses the default account's configuration, kept in sync before every run.
configDialog.startCopy: A copy of the shared one

group.unlinked: No longer linked: the account starts without them

configDialog.nothing: Nothing to copy, link or move.
configDialog.history: Chat history and agent memory stay shared in both modes.
configDialog.planFailed: Could not work out what the change would do

projectRule.title: Accounts
projectRule.none: Any account may work on this project, as the rotation settings say.
projectRule.alsoGoverns: This rule also covers {{projects}}: a change here applies there too.
projectRule.allowedSome_one: {{n}} of {{total}} accounts may work here; work waits rather than run on another.
projectRule.allowedSome_other: {{n}} of {{total}} accounts may work here; work waits rather than run on another.
projectRule.preferredOn: Work here starts on {{name}} while it has room.
projectRule.preferredOff: Work here starts where your preferred account and the rotation say.
projectRule.reserveSwitch: Keep headroom while this project has work
projectRule.reserveOn: While this project has work, other projects leave {{name}} at {{at}} instead of {{threshold}}.
projectRule.reserveOff: Other projects use {{name}} up to the threshold, whether this project has work or not.
projectRule.reserveNeedsAccount: Choose a preferred account, or limit the accounts allowed, to say where the headroom is kept.
projectRule.strictOn: A chat only moves to an account with the same configuration; otherwise it waits.
projectRule.strictOff: A chat may move to an account with another configuration when no other has room.
projectRule.removeBody: Any account may work on the project again. Running chats stay on their account.
projectRule.removeBodyShared: The rule also covers {{projects}}: they lose it too. Running chats stay on their account.
